QuestInfo.1: Kriel the Fairy doesn't know Areda at all. Kriel says she might not be a Nymph but a Slyph of Ellinia. Maybe the #bheadmistress of Ellinel Fairy Academy#k will know.

QuestInfo.0: Areda insists she's a fairy from Orbis. Ask the fairies of Orbis if this is true.
